notes.title: Demo Live for NextFest!
notes.content:
Alchemical INC. is getting in on the Summer NextFest excitement! A free demo is available that shows off the first moments of life in New Folk City.

[h3]Demo Features[/h3]
🔍Mix & match powerful Elementals
🧐Dynamic Deckbuilding & Trading
🎲Roguelike sessions

Feel free to post your feedback in the forums. We want to use this demo as a way to find improvements in order to release the best final version of the game.

See ya in the city streets,
Looch

notes.title: Demo v0.0.24.7 is live!
notes.content:
Here is a small patch for reported demo bugs.

[list]
[*] Discovered recipes will now save correctly and persist between play sessions.
[*] Fixed a bug where an Alchemist will not die if it has 0 Health and 1+ Power.
[*] Amplify damage boost no longer effects Burn debuff damage.
[*] Fixed wall gaps that let players escape into undeveloped parts of the city.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has checked out the demo and submitted your feedback!

-Looch
